failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than the average of the last 14 days, despite the observed drops in WORKPLACES and rise in RESIDENTIAL.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days shows an increase, despite the significant drop in TRANSIT mobility in a tightening restrictions regime.
